title: Stonebridge: The Lost Seal
introduction: The toll bridge is closed after its keeper vanished. The notice board directs travellers to the archive chest for the bridge seal. Recover it and decide whether to reopen the crossing or keep it closed. A raider den is an optional, dangerous detour.
objective: Find the bridge seal, examine the bridge instructions, fit the seal, and make a final crossing decision.

locations.name: Toll Yard
locations.description: A notice board explains how the bridge seal works. The archive is open. A separate path leads to a raider den; combat begins there.

locations.name: Bridge Archives
locations.description: An unlocked archive chest holds the bridge instructions and seal. Ordinary examination requires no ability check.

locations.name: Stonebridge Span
locations.description: The bridge gate is closed. A seal socket beside its controls accepts the recovered bridge seal. Fitting it enables a final crossing decision.

locations.name: Raider Den
locations.description: A toll raider guards stolen supplies. Entering commits you to combat; the bridge can be resolved without this detour.

features.name: bridge notice board
features.description: The archive chest contains the lost bridge seal. Read and recover it, then fit it at the bridge socket.

features.name: unlocked archive chest
features.description: A chest containing the bridge instructions and seal. Search it to record the instructions; the seal is visible and portable.

features.name: bridge seal socket
features.description: Fit the recovered bridge seal here, outside combat. This spends the seal once, costs no time or dice, and does not heal.

features.name: stone barricade
features.description: Solid cover. Brace once in this encounter for +4 AC against one enemy attack.

discoveries.title: Bridge instructions
discoveries.summary: The recovered instructions identify the seal and controls. The keeper remains missing.
discoveries.lead: Take the bridge seal, fit it at Stonebridge Span, then choose the final crossing policy.

discoveries.title: Fitted bridge seal
discoveries.summary: The seal is fitted. Opening or securing the crossing still requires an explicit final decision.
discoveries.lead: Choose an offered crossing policy at the span.

searches.text: You record the bridge instructions. The seal opens the controls, but it does not prove the missing keeper is safe.

thresholds.text: Ten journey days have passed. The bridge still awaits your decision.

items.name: bridge seal
items.description: A keyed seal for the bridge socket. Fitting spends it once and provides no healing.

monsterDefinitions.name: toll raider
monsterDefinitions.description: A lone raider demanding payment. This optional fight does not determine the keeper’s fate.

fates.text: The keeper remains missing; the crossing decision confirms no rescue.

consequences.text: The bridge gate is open. Travellers may cross; no off-screen arrival or rescue is established.

narration.text: You turn the recovered seal and open Stonebridge. The adventure is complete.

consequences.text: The bridge remains closed and the seal is secured. Travellers must wait or take another route.

narration.text: You secure the bridge controls and post the closure. The adventure is complete.

checks.successText: You connect the seal to the gate interlock. The archive instructions provide the full procedure without a check.
checks.failureText: You cannot infer the interlock from the notice. The unlocked archive still provides all required instructions.
